limits: Finite checks do not prove geometric, analytic or source classification theorems. Rational square-root helper is an exact-fixture evaluator, not a general numerical inversion package.

mathematical_scope.analytic_uniqueness: Both competitors must have analytic support functions and positive curvature.
mathematical_scope.non_even_classification: Non-even mixed-area representation retains continuity, homogeneous decomposition, degree-two volume and degree-one mixed-area classification dependencies; original classical proofs not fully inspected or independently re-proved.
mathematical_scope.source_corrections: Normalization observations apply only to the inspected arXiv:1307.1529v2 manuscript, not uninspected publisher text.
mathematical_scope.strictness: Strong strictness includes lower-dimensional nonempty inclusions; body-strict area monotonicity is insufficient for that definition.
mathematical_scope.switching_pair: Exact uniform boundary-collar perimeter-covariogram equality only; no full interior equality or target counterexample.
mathematical_scope.two_scale_identity: Requires genuinely additional dilated-body observation, alpha > 0, t > 0, t != 1; not obtained by resampling the original function.
